Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the public records exemptions accountability committee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the public records exemptions accountabilitycommittee; adding a new section to chapter 42.56 RCW; and adding newsections to chapter 43.131 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The public records exemptions accountability committee iscreated to review all exemptions from public disclosure under thischapter and throughout the Revised Code of Washington. (2) The committee consists of fifteen members as follows: (a) A representative appointed by the governor; (b) A representative appointed by the attorney general; (c) A representative appointed by the state auditor; (d) A representative of local government, to be selected by thegovernor; (e) A representative of a statewide media association, to beselected by the attorney general; (f) A member of the senate, to be selected by the senate majorityleader; p. 1 SSB 5435 (g) A member of the senate, to be selected by the senate minorityleader; (h) A member of the house of representatives, to be selected by thespeaker of the house of representatives; (i) A member of the house of representatives, to be selected by thehouse of representatives minority leader; (j) Four members of the public, to be selected by the nine membersdescribed in (a) through (i) of this subsection. Members of the publicshall be selected with consideration given to diversity of viewpointand geographic diversity; (k) A representative appointed by the state archivist; and (l) A representative appointed by the director of financialmanagement. (3) The committee members shall elect a member of the committee toserve as chair of the committee. (4) Terms of the members shall be two years and shall be staggered,beginning August 1, 2007. (5) All meetings of the committee shall be open to the public. (6) The committee must consider input from interested parties. (7) By August 1, 2007, the code reviser shall provide the committeewith a list of all exemptions from public disclosure under this chapterthat are not codified in this chapter. (8) The committee shall meet by September 1, 2007, to discuss theexemptions and recommend the repeal or amendment of any exemptions. ByJanuary 1, 2008, the committee shall transmit its initialrecommendations to the appropriate committees of the house ofrepresentatives and the senate. (9) Beginning in 2008, the code reviser shall by August 1st of eachyear provide the committee with a list of all exemptions from publicdisclosure under this chapter that are not codified in this chapter.The committee shall meet a minimum of four times each year. Each year,the committee shall prepare a list of exemptions, if any, that itrecommends for repeal or amendment, and transmit the information toappropriate committees of the legislature by December 1st of that year.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.131 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The public records exemptions accountability committee and itspowers and duties shall be terminated June 30, 2011, as provided insection 3 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.131 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 42.56. (section 1 of this act) as now existing or hereafteramended, is repealed, effective June 30, 2012.
